'''Retsef Levi''' ({{langx|he|רצף לוי}}; born March 7, 1971) is an Israeli [[applied mathematician]] and [[management scientist]]. He is the J. Spencer Standish Professor of Operations Management at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] (MIT).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-04-14 |title=Retsef Levi, J. Spencer Standish (1945) Professor of Operations Management |url=https://mitsloan.mit.edu/faculty/directory/retsef-levi |access-date=2025-06-18 |website= |publisher=[[MIT Sloan School of Management]] |language=en}}</ref> 

In June 2025, [[Robert F. Kennedy Jr.]], [[U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services]], appointed Levi as a member of the [[Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices]] (ACIP) at the [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] (CDC).

== Early life and education ==
Levi was born on March 7, 1971, in [[Tel Aviv]], Israel.<ref>{{Cite thesis |last=Levi |first=Retsef |title=Computing Provably Near-Optimal Policies for Stochastic Inventory Control Models |date=2005 |access-date=18 June 2025 |degree=PhD |publisher=[[Cornell University]] |url=https://mitsloan.mit.edu/shared/ods/documents?PublicationDocumentID=7654}}</ref> He is a brother of Israeli screenwriter [[Reshef Levi]] and Israeli author [[Yannets Levi]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite news |last=Arlosoroff |first=Meirav |date=January 22, 2021 |title=Three lockdowns, but still many COVID deaths: How Israel failed to manage the pandemic |url=https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2021-01-22/ty-article/.premium/unprofessional-opaque-and-aimless-experts-weigh-in-on-israels-pandemic-failures/0000017f-f37c-d8a1-a5ff-f3fe627e0000 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250417025033/https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2021-01-22/ty-article/.premium/unprofessional-opaque-and-aimless-experts-weigh-in-on-israels-pandemic-failures/0000017f-f37c-d8a1-a5ff-f3fe627e0000 |archive-date=2025-04-17 |access-date=2025-06-19 |work=[[Haaretz]] |language=en |url-status=live }}</ref> 

From 1990 to 2001, Levi served in the [[Israel Defense Forces]] (IDF). Beginning in 1991, he was an [[intelligence officer]] of the elite [[Israeli Intelligence Corps]], first as a lieutenant [[Intelligence analysis|intelligence analyst]] (1990–1992), then as a captain (1992–1994) and then major, or ''[[Israel Defense Forces ranks|Rav séren]]'' (1994–1996).<ref name="mitsloan" />

While serving in the Israeli military, Levi graduated ''[[summa cum laude]]'' from [[Tel Aviv University]] in 2001 with a [[Bachelor of Science|B.Sc.]] in mathematics. He then completed doctoral studies in the United States at [[Cornell University]], where he earned his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] in [[operations research]] and [[mathematical programming]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018 |title=Profile: Retsef Levi |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=92033 |access-date=18 June 2025 |publisher=[[Mathematics Genealogy Project]]}}</ref> in 2005 under professors Robin Roundy and [[David Shmoys]]. His dissertation was entitled "Computing Provably Near-Optimal Policies for Stochastic Inventory Control Models".<ref name="mitsloan">{{Cite web |date=January 2025 |title=Curriculum Vitae: Retsef Levi |url=https://mitsloan.mit.edu/shared/ods/documents?PersonID=41407&DocID=12731 |access-date=2025-06-18 |publisher=[[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]]}}</ref> Professors [[James Renegar]] and Shane Henderson also advised Levi's thesis.<ref name="mitsloan" />

== Career ==
Levi is a data scientist and former intelligence officer in the Israeli military.<ref>{{cite news |title=Retsef Levi: MIT professor is at center of RFK Jr. vaccine effort |url=https://www.bostonglobe.com/2025/10/21/metro/retsef-levi-vaccines-mit/ |access-date=10 March 2026 |work=Bost Globe |date=21 Oct 2025}}</ref> After receiving his doctorate, Levi completed [[postdoctoral research]] at the [[IBM T.J. Watson Research Center]], where he was the Goldstine Postdoctoral Fellow at the Department of Mathematical Sciences. He became an assistant professor of management in 2006 at the [[MIT Sloan School of Management]], where he held a position as a Robert N. Noyce Career Development Professor. He was promoted to an associate professor with  [[Academic tenure|tenure]] in July 2009 and received the school's appointment as its J. Spencer Standish Professor of Operations Management in July 2010.<ref name="mitsloan" />

Levi was [[associate editor]] of the peer-reviewed academic journals [[Management Science (journal)|''Management Science'']] (from 2009 to 2014), ''[[Mathematics of Operations Research]]'' (from 2009 to 2015), ''[[Naval Research Logistics]]'' (from 2009 to 2015), and [[Operations Research (journal)|''Operations Research'']] (from 2011 to 2018).<ref name="mitsloan" />

In 2021, Israeli minister of education [[Yoav Gallant]] appointed Levi to a panel of experts tasked with advising the government on the reopening of schools during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]].<ref name=":1" /> Levi was a critic of the [[Israeli Ministry of Health]]'s policy of closing schools during the pandemic, which he considered unnecessary.<ref name=":1" />

=== Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, 2025 ===
Levi is a critic of [[COVID-19 lockdowns]] and [[mRNA vaccines]],<ref name=":0" /> and a [[COVID-19 vaccine skeptic]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bonavitacola |first=Julia |date=2025-06-12 |title=Vaccine Skeptics Among CDC Vaccine Panel Replacements Named by RFK Jr |url=https://www.ajmc.com/view/vaccine-skeptics-among-cdc-vaccine-panel-replacements-named-by-rfk-jr |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=[[The American Journal of Managed Care]] |language=en}}</ref> He has published papers on the [[mortality rates]] of COVID-19 vaccines.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gilson |first=Grace |date=13 June 2025 |title=RFK appoints anti-mRNA technology Israeli MIT professor to vaccine advisory panel |url=https://www.timesofisrael.com/rfk-appoints-anti-mrna-technology-israeli-mit-professor-to-vaccine-advisory-panel/ |access-date=2025-06-18 |website=[[The Times of Israel]] |language=en-US}}</ref> He wrote on [[Twitter]] in 2023 that “the evidence is mounting and indisputable that mRNA vaccines cause serious harm including death, especially among young people".<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |last=Stolberg |first=Sheryl Gay |date=2025-06-11 |title=Kennedy Announces Eight New Members of C.D.C. Vaccine Advisory Panel |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/06/11/us/politics/rfk-jr-cdc-vaccine-panel.html |access-date=2025-06-18 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref> On June 11, 2025, [[Robert F. Kennedy Jr.]], the [[U.S. secretary of health and human services|U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services]], announced that he appointed Levi as one of the members of the [[Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices]] (ACIP).<ref name=":0" /> However, Levi did not have medical, epidemiological, or immunological training, experience, or background.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Ledford |first1=Heidi |last2=Fieldhouse |first2=Rachel |date=2025-06-12 |title=Who is on RFK Jr's new vaccine panel — and what will they do? |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-025-01852-z |journal=Nature |volume=642 |issue=8069 |pages=846–848 |language=en |doi=10.1038/d41586-025-01852-z |issn=1476-4687 |pmid=40514522 |bibcode=2025Natur.642..846L |url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Goldman |first=Maya |date=2025-09-19 |title=RFK Jr.'s advisory panel drops broad COVID vaccine recommendation |url=https://www.axios.com/2025/09/19/covid-vaccine-vote-cdc-recommendations |access-date=2025-09-19 |website=Axios |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-08-25 |title=ACIP member critical of COVID vaccines to lead review {{!}} CIDRAP |url=https://www.cidrap.umn.edu/covid-19/acip-member-critical-covid-vaccines-lead-review |access-date=2025-09-19 |website=www.cidrap.umn.edu |language=en}}</ref>  Levi was removed from his position on the ACIP in 2026 when a ruling in ''[[Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices#American Academy of Pediatrics v. Kennedy|American Academy of Pediatrics v. Kennedy]]'' invalidated the entire committee's appointments.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Schreiber |first=Melody |date=2026-03-16 |title=Federal judge blocks RFK Jr's overhaul of vaccine recommendations |url=https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/mar/16/judge-blocks-rfk-jr-vaccine-policy-changes |access-date=2026-03-20 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref>
